title: Fleet months
description: DRAFT, finalized in Phase 4 (time slider). Monthly fleet sizes for every airline in a columnar layout: one months array, and per airline count arrays aligned to it. Rules JSON Schema can't check: months is ascending with no gaps; every count array has the same length as months; for each month, by_family values sum to totals; airline_id values reference airlines.json.

months.description: Every month covered, ascending with no gaps.

airlines.description: One entry per airline that had a fleet in any covered month, sorted by airline_id.

countSeries.title: CountSeries
countSeries.description: One count per entry in months, in the same order.

airlineSeries.title: AirlineFleetSeries
airlineSeries.description: One airline's fleet size over time.

by_family.description: Fleet size per month for each type family the airline ever operated, keyed by family in ascending order.
